faq.title: XKR 508PS FAQs
faq.description: Answers covering costs, warranty, outputs and fitting for the supercharged Jaguar XKR 508PS engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XKR 508PS engine replacement?
faqs.a: It depends on the engine type, its output and whether we carry out the fitting. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your 508PS engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Engines we supply carry a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you place an order.

faqs.q: Which 508PS outputs were fitted to the XKR?
faqs.a: Parts catalogues list the XKR at 510PS and 530PS, with the XKR-S at 550PS. We identify your exact version from the VIN before matching a replacement engine.

faqs.q: Is there a 471hp version of the XKR 508PS?
faqs.a: Not in the XKR. Catalogues list a 471PS tune of the 508PS for the XJ instead. XKR versions start at 510PS, so we always check the donor's original application.
No. Early X150 XKRs used a supercharged 4.2-litre V8. The 508PS arrived in 2009, so we confirm which engine your XKR has using its VIN.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XKR 508PS engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include supercharger isolator noise, timing chain tensioner wear, water pump and coolant leaks, and ignition faults. Symptoms overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: What does your XKR supply and fit service cover?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XKR. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Making the Right Call on Your XKR's 508PS
workshopIntro.description: Begin with an accurate diagnosis. Supercharger isolator noise, water pump leaks and coil faults can often be repaired without opening the engine. If chain failure or overheating has caused internal damage, weigh the repair estimate against your XKR's condition and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XKR 508PS engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its output and history, and whether we fit it. Installing a supercharged V8 in a grand tourer is labour-intensive, so complete supply and fit quotes allow a fair comparison.

When browsing 508PS 5.0 V8 supercharged petrol engine UK listings, ask which model and output each engine came from. Units from saloons or SUVs may differ in ancillaries, so confirm mileage and history carefully too.

Finally, look at the warranty. A Jaguar XKR 508PS engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault appears after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms and any conditions before you buy.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XKR 508PS Engine Problems Owners Encounter
engineProblems.description: Any of these could signal a fault; diagnosis confirms the true cause.

cards.title: Idle Rattle From Supercharger
cards.description: A rattling sound at idle that settles as revs rise may indicate wear in the supercharger coupling or isolator.
cards.action: Book a supercharger drive inspection soon.

cards.title: Cold-Start Chain Noise
cards.description: A rattle lasting a few seconds after the engine has stood overnight could suggest worn timing chain tensioners or guides.
cards.action: Arrange a timing system check promptly.

cards.title: Coolant Level Falling
cards.description: Repeated top-ups or a sweet smell may point to a leaking water pump, thermostat housing or coolant pipe.
cards.action: Request a cooling system pressure test.

cards.title: Power Drops When Hot
cards.description: Performance fading after hard driving might relate to the charge cooler pump or low-temperature circuit not cooling intake air.
cards.action: Have the charge cooling system tested.

cards.title: Misfires Under Boost
cards.description: Stuttering under acceleration or a flashing engine light could stem from ignition coils, spark plugs or fuel injectors.

cards.title: Oil Weeping From Seals
cards.description: Oil around the cam covers, timing covers or sump, or a burning smell, may indicate ageing gaskets or seals.

engineOverview.title: Understanding the 508PS Behind the X150 XKR
paragraphs: The 508PS is the supercharged version of Jaguar's 5.0-litre AJ133 V8, built with direct injection and chain-driven camshafts. Parts catalogues list it in the XKR from early 2009 at 510PS, with a 530PS version from late 2010 and the XKR-S rated at 550PS from 2011.

Searches for a Jaguar XKR 5.0 V8 supercharged petrol engine 471hp need checking. Catalogues show the 471PS tune in the XJ, while XF saloon data lists a 470PS version. Neither matches XKR figures, so we confirm the donor's output before supplying.

A Jaguar XKR 508PS engine 2006 won't match either. The first X150 XKR used a supercharged 4.2-litre V8, and the 5.0 only replaced it in 2009. Because outputs and calibrations vary, your VIN decides which replacement engine is the correct one.
